name: Nagisawa Chizuna
source:
A very nice and kind onee-san in her twenties who is the waitress leader of the Daybreak Cafe. Always a very good advisor. She learned to make good coffee during one of her previous part-time jobs. She was very bad at first, but has since been a specialist in coffee making (but she isn't particularly fond of coffee).

She often deals with expelling [url=https://vndb.org/c19115]Oikawa[/url] from the Daybreak Cafe because it is "a pervert who frightens the customers". Oikawa ended up nicknamed her the "Maiden Witch".

She also is the senpai of [url=https://vndb.org/c11964]Umi[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c11967]Sonya[/url] at the Daybreak Cafe.
